data.description: Experience Bright, Contemporary Living at PASSO
data.display_address: Passo by Beyond, Palm Jumeirah, Dubai
data.long_description:
Discover the perfect fusion of elegance and coastal charm at PASSO, Beyond by Omniyat’s exclusive residential complex on Palm Jumeirah. The two sculptural towers offer a fresh architectural perspective with sleek façades that flow harmoniously with the surrounding sea views. This sophisticated development invites residents to enjoy a tranquil yet vibrant lifestyle.

The interiors are designed to enhance everyday living with open, light-filled spaces that feel both stylish and comfortable. Expansive windows offer stunning vistas and ensure that natural light floods every corner of the home. At PASSO, modern design meets serene living to create an exceptional residence by the sea.
